name: Villa Dubrovnik
insider_take: Perched dramatically on the cliffs of Dubrovnik's Ploče district, Villa Dubrovnik is a sun-drenched Adriatic sanctuary where the shimmering sea meets timeless Croatian elegance — a world apart from the Old Town crowds, yet just a short boat ride away.
whats_special: This intimate Leading Hotels of the World member commands breathtaking panoramic views of the Adriatic and the UNESCO-listed Dubrovnik Old Town. With just 56 rooms and suites, Villa Dubrovnik offers a rare sense of exclusivity on the Dalmatian Coast. Its cliffside positioning means nearly every room enjoys a front-row view of the sea, while the hotel's private boat shuttle whisks guests directly to the Old City Harbor — a detail that feels almost impossibly glamorous.
pro_tip: Request a room on an upper floor facing the sea — at sunset, the golden light reflecting off the Adriatic and illuminating the ancient city walls is simply unforgettable. Book the private boat transfer rather than walking; it's a short ride that feels like a scene from a movie.
dont_miss: Dinner at the hotel's cliffside Restaurant & Bar Bura is an absolute must — the locally-sourced Dalmatian cuisine paired with those sweeping sea views is a combination that's hard to top anywhere on the Croatian coast. Also, take a dip in the stunning saltwater infinity pool carved into the rock face — it practically merges with the Adriatic horizon.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic Adriatic Sea views
Walking distance to Dubrovnik's historic Old Town
Luxurious rooms with private terraces overlooking the sea
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
